gloss: to be able to sleep; sleeping

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {眠|ねむ}れていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be able to sleep; can sleep
definitions.explanation: The potential form of {眠|ねむ}る, indicating the ability to fall asleep or sleep well.
Used as an attributive adjective ({連体形|れんたいけい}) meaning "sleeping" or "dormant," as in {眠|ねむ}れる{森|もり} (sleeping forest).

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れ→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧た。
examples.english: I was able to sleep well last night.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}みすぎ→飲みすぎ：22059_nomisugi⟧て⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: I drank too much coffee and can't sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦でないと→でないと：30684_denaito⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some people can't sleep unless the environment is quiet.

examples.japanese: {眠|ねむ}れる⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧。
examples.english: Sleeping Beauty (literally: the sleeping forest's beauty).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{眠|ねむ}れる⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are still many dormant resources in this region.

examples.japanese: {眠|ねむ}れる⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目覚|めざ}めさせる→目覚める：04649_mezameru⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: A trigger is needed to awaken dormant talent.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the potential form of ⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧ and is very common in everyday speech, especially in the negative (⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧ — can't sleep).

Sense 2 is a literary usage where {眠|ねむ}れる functions as an attributive form meaning "sleeping" or "dormant." This is the classical Japanese ⟦{已然形|いぜんけい}→已然形：26736_izenkei⟧ (realis form) used as a modifier, most famously seen in {眠|ねむ}れる⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{美女|びじょ}→美女：28612_bijo⟧ (Sleeping Beauty).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{眠|ねむ}れる (to sleep well / to be able to sleep well)
- ⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧ (a sleepless night)
- {眠|ねむ}れる⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧ (sleeping forest)
- {眠|ねむ}れる⟦{獅子|しし}→獅子：04944_shishi⟧ (sleeping lion — figurative for hidden potential)
